items.note: Both noun and verb, with no change of form.

items.example: 她拿到了深圳的一个职位。
items.example_en: She got a position in Shenzhen.
items.note: 拿到 is a result complement: got hold of.
Also a respectful form of address for any teacher or expert.

items.example_en: She works as a night nurse at the hospital.
items.note: 当 plus a profession means to work as.
师 marks skilled professions: 老师, 律师, 工程师.

items.example: 我做自由职业已经五年了。
items.example_en: I've been freelancing for five years.
items.note: 已经 ... 了 frames a continuing state.
都 before the verb means all, referring back to the subject.

items.example: 老板今天早上想见我们。
items.example_en: The boss wants to see us this morning.
items.note: Also how you address a shop owner or restaurant owner.
兼职 is part-time.
假 here is jià (leave), not jiǎ (false).

items.example_en: I worked overtime every day this week.
items.note: Doubling 天天 means every single day.

items.example_en: The salary here is pretty good.
items.note: 还不错 means not bad, a common understated compliment.
Pronounced with a rising second tone on the phone, not the usual fourth.

items.example: 稍等，我帮您转接技术部。
items.example_en: One moment, I'll transfer you to technical support.
items.note: 帮 plus person plus verb means to do something for someone.
稍 means slightly, so 稍等 is wait just a moment.

items.example_en: The meeting has been moved to Thursday.
items.note: 开会 is the verb, 会议 the noun. 改到 means changed to.

items.example_en: That item isn't on the agenda.
items.note: 项 is the measure word for items on a list.
Standard Chinese office vocabulary.
Chinese business letters address people by surname plus title.

items.example: 关于三月的发票，我有一个问题。
items.example_en: Regarding the March invoice, I have a question.
items.note: Comes at the front of the sentence.
简历 is a CV or resume.

items.example_en: Looking forward to your reply, thank you.

items.note: The traditional formal closing, written on two lines in letters.

items.example_en: Sorry to trouble you, many thanks.
items.note: A courteous closing that softens any request.

items.example_en: All these new words have to be learnt by heart.
items.note: Same character as 背 back (bèi); 下来 marks the words as fixed in memory.

items.example: 我在复习星期五的考试。
items.note: 预习 is to preview material before class.
Both noun and verb.
上 as a result complement: the exam achieved its purpose. Failing is 没考上.
上课 is to attend class, 下课 is class ending.

items.example_en: I take notes on my computer.
items.note: 用 plus tool comes before the verb.
Literally electric brain.
Literally secret code.

items.example_en: Download the file before the meeting.
items.note: 上传 is to upload. 载 is zài here, not zǎi.
打不开 is a negative potential complement: cannot be opened.

items.example_en: The site has been lagging since this morning.
items.note: Informal but universal. Same 卡 as in card, but here it means stuck.
重 is chóng (again) here, not zhòng (heavy).
